title: character.json
description: Whole path of one character for pipeline/character.py. Paths are relative to the file. Keys starting with _ are comments; unknown keys are allowed.

prop_model.description: optional separate prop mesh (GLB/FBX) in the model's frame, where it rests on the body: joined for rigging but left out of joint detection and weights; rig.json `prop` then needs no select or debris

walk_clip.description: optional library walk (Mixamo skeleton): calibration, merged next to every AI action, auto-rig template when `auto_rig_template` is missing; without any, the rig needs no Mixamo file

ground.description: what every action's lowest foot point is put on: an action name, or @rest (the rest pose's feet). Default: walk, else the first library action, else @rest

auto_rig_template.description: Mixamo FBX: auto_rig builds the `mixamorig:*` skeleton from it. Without it and without a library walk (or with skeleton amts) auto_rig builds the own skeleton

skeleton.description: skeleton profile of `rig`: a built-in name (skeletons/*.json: amts, mixamo, soma) or a .json path; default mixamo with a template, amts without one

actions.description: action name -> action; every key is an action (no _ comments here)

library.description: Mixamo-skeleton clip (FBX/GLB); on a rig of another skeleton its bones go by role

motion.description: grip-only motion file for a library action with a prop
